results.title: Best Budget GPU for Local LLMs 2026: RTX 3060 12GB
results.snippet: RTX 3060 12GB runs Qwen3 14B at 9–12 tok/sec, Qwen3 8B at 16–20 tok/sec, Gemma 4 E12B at 11–14 tok/sec, Mistral Small at 18 tok/sec, and DeepSeek-R1 7B at 10–12 tok/sec — all at Q4 quantization.
